text: {"fixed_clause": "The company reserves the right to process all applicant disclosures, including medical history, health conditions, and religious affiliations where provided, under the framework of legitimate human resources interest to support targeted corporate wellness initiatives and internal profiling, provided that promotional communications are sent to personal contact channels only with the recipient's prior consent and include a clear way to stop receiving them."}

data.fixed_clause: The company reserves the right to process all applicant disclosures, including medical history, health conditions, and religious affiliations where provided, under the framework of legitimate human resources interest to support targeted corporate wellness initiatives and internal profiling, provided that promotional communications are sent to personal contact channels only with the recipient's prior consent and include a clear way to stop receiving them.
